The '''falumpaset''' (plural: '''falumpaset''' or '''falumpasets''') was a large mammal native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Behavior==
They roamed the plains, forests and [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of the planet (their long, stilt-like legs being excellent for wading) in large herds (as well as in family groups containing one adult bull and four to seven adult cows and their young),<ref name=":0">{{DB|creature|falumpaset|falumpaset}}</ref> and their distinctive bellowing calls could be heard for kilometers around. Easily domesticated, falumpasets were popular mounts all over the galaxy. They were, however, known for their stubborn and uncooperative temperament. Wild falumpaset had long shaggy fetlocks to protect against nipping [[nyork]]s, etc.<ref name=":1">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> They were excellent swimmers.<ref name=":0" /> Bigger enemies included [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monsters]] breaching the surface of the swamps from the abyssal ocean beneath.

The [[Terazod/Legends|terazod]], the falumpaset, and the [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]] represented three different within the Gungan Swamps: they were three plant-eaters that existed in the same territory but had different feeding strategies. In the case of the falumpaset, when feeding underwater, it could only reach midlevel crustaceans and plants.<ref name=":1" />

==Biology and appearance==
Falumpasets were large [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] found in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. They were omnivorous creatures, and ate both [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

A breed of falumpaset was also native to the jungle world of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. They were gray in color and had dark strips across their back.<ref name="Onderon arc" />

==History==
[[File:Falumpaset-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Wild falumpasets engage in twilight bellowing.]]
Two specially trained [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] handlers were required to properly control a falumpaset. According to [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] fables, such handlers aren't allowed to form close relationships with other beings lest the stubborn falumpasets grow jealous and even more ornery.<ref name=":0" />

Because of their great strength, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] used them to pull their [[Gungan battle wagon/Legends|Battle Wagons]] at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]]. In the following victory parade, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] rode a falumpaset through the streets of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
According to information ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' got from art designer [[Terryl Whitlatch]], the "notoriously stubborn" falumpaset:

"[May be easily confused with] the [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]]...But the falumpaset is much smaller and mammalian in appearance. When Jar Jar accidentally opens the back gate of a [[battle wagon]] and releases a payload of [[Booma/Legends|energy balls]], the creature pulling the wagon is a falumpaset. 'The falumpaset is like a rhinoceros,' says Whitlach. 'A giant extinct rhinoceros, but without horns. I experimented with legs and like the look of a Clydesdale horse, so the falumpaset has the stocky sturdy legs of a Clydesdale.' Falumpasets don't look much like elephants, but behaviorally they are close kin. Elephants are so intelligent that they have shown evidence of tool-using and sophisticated communication...Falumpasets are as intelligent as elephants, which is both a blessing and a curse to their [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] trainers, since the creatures are notoriously stubborn."<ref name="Creatures of Episode I">{{InsiderCite|47|Creatures of Episode I}}</ref>

The falumpaset's coloring in {{Film|I}} was inspired by that of an Appaloosa [[Horse/Legends|horse]].<ref name=":0" />

The falumpaset, along with [[Pikobi/Legends|pikobis]] and fambaas, are identified as also being a native animal to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in the trivia slideshow for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[A War on Two Fronts]]."<ref name="Onderon arc" />
